headline: India Glycols Limited sets record date of 2 September 2026 for merger/hive-off
sum: India Glycols Limited has notified the NSE of a record date of 2 September 2026 for a merger or hive-off transaction. The announcement signals advanced stage preparation for a corporate restructuring, with shareholder entitlements tied to the record date.
implication: Record-date notification indicates the deal framework and consideration have been finalised and regulatory approvals are substantially complete; counsel should verify NCLT sanction order status and ensure scheme of arrangement disclosures comply with listing rules before the cutoff.
detail: India Glycols Limited formally communicated to the NSE that the record date for merger or hive-off purposes is 2 September 2026. A record date is set only after scheme of arrangement approval by NCLT and satisfaction of listing rule conditions, signifying the transaction is in final execution phase. The specific structure-whether a merger (amalgamation) or demerger (hive-off)-and the counterparty have not been disclosed in this exchange notice; further disclosure should be imminent via stock exchange filings.
